observations: Photo 0 shows a disassembled car engine sitting on pavement, with wiring harness, intake manifold, hoses, and connectors visible.
A spare wheel/rim is partially visible in the background to the left.
A watermark 'TI AUTOMOBILE' appears on the image, likely the seller's business name, not a brand on the engine.
No manufacturer badge, part number, or VIN/engine code is legible anywhere on the block or components.
Engine appears to have surface dirt and some wear consistent with a used part, but no visible cracks or leaks confirmed from this single angle.

claims.evidence: No import documentation, origin tag, or distinguishing mark visible in photo 0 to confirm direct import status.

risks.risk: Engine make, model, and displacement cannot be determined, which drives most of the price variance for engines.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine block casting number, manufacturer badge, or a VIN/engine code plate.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; price-setting identity is missing

risks.risk: Working condition (compression, no knocking, electronics functioning) cannot be assessed from a static photo.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running or a compression test readout.

risks.risk: Completeness of the engine (turbo, sensors, ECU, starter, alternator) is unclear; some ancillary parts may be missing.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos showing all sides of the engine including accessory mounts.

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion, cracked block, or oil/coolant leaks not visible from one dusty photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of block seams, oil pan, and a photo after wiping down dirt.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any casting numbers, manufacturer badge, or engine code stamped on the block.
Video of the engine cranking or running to demonstrate it operates.
Additional photos from multiple angles showing turbo, sensors, and accessory completeness.
Photo of the vehicle or parts invoice this engine was pulled from, to confirm fitment.
response.reason: The photo shows a generic used engine with no readable brand, model, or displacement markings, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without knowing what engine this is.
